audit: DOCUMENTED-ONLY: a signed registry activated unconditionally with no previous-good, rollback or history; nothing searched a policy offline, held out a partition, checked calibration/replay/propensity evidence or staged a canary.
proof: Real Core, host sandbox, signed registries, scripted provider, 62 real verified tasks as statistics, the EPR-019 calibration suite; activation, canary, promotion, rollback and restart through the one registry publisher.
negative_proof: Eight mutations each fail the qualification: no install CAS, no previous-good check, revocations not kept, no floor check, replay evidence ignored, the search not reproduced, canary routing for every task, a canary request not required to be routed under the canary.
limitations: Only the auto floor is searched; routing performs no exploration; rollback triggers are operator actions; no threshold profile is owner-approved (docs/61 §5 item 3), so the qualification's profiles are labelled fixtures and no production promotion has occurred.
